svg.title: Hemolytic anemia: once the hemolysis labs are up, the direct antiglobulin test splits warm and cold autoimmune hemolysis from DAT-negative G6PD deficiency and hereditary spherocytosis, told apart by the film; schistocytes, microspherocytes or parasites on the film point to a cause from outside the cell

svg.text: every one: ↑ indirect bilirubin · ↑ lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) · ↑ reticulocytes · ↓ haptoglobin

svg.text: then the direct antiglobulin test (DAT) and the film

svg.text: DAT POSITIVE: antibody on the cell

svg.text: Film first: TORN or TINY cells mean a cause from outside

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • SCHISTOCYTES: mechanical valve or leak, marathon · DIC, TTP, HUS

svg.text: • MICROSPHEROCYTES: clostridial sepsis, burns · PARASITES: malaria
